title: Size Chart: Find Your Size in US, UK and EU Sizes
description: Get one clear size for any country or brand, free and with no account. Enter a size you wear or your own measurements, and see what to do between sizes.

routes.title: Size Chart: Find Your Size in US, UK and EU
routes.description: Size chart lookup: enter a size you wear or your bust, waist and hip, pick a country or brand, and get one size, the rule for between two sizes, and how the brand runs.

routes.title: Size chart data sources: About
routes.description: Size Chart turns measurements and brand charts into one size in US, UK and EU sizing. Where the data comes from, how a result is made and who runs the site.

routes.title: Contact Size Chart: Send a Message About a Size
routes.description: Write to Size Chart about a size that looks wrong, a brand we do not carry, a paid plan or a deletion request, and find out what to include.
routes.navLabel: Contact Size Chart: Send a Message About a Size

routes.title: Size Chart Pricing: Free Size Conversion, Plus and Pro
routes.description: Free size chart conversion for one country or brand at a time. Plus and Pro add saved profiles, followed brands and comparison PDF exports. Cancel anytime.
routes.navLabel: Size Chart Pricing: Free Size Conversion, Plus and Pro

routes.title: Size Chart Privacy: What the Site Stores
routes.description: Size Chart works out a size in your browser. What is stored on a free plan, what a paid profile keeps, and how to have it deleted.
routes.navLabel: Size Chart Privacy: What the Site Stores

routes.title: Size Chart Terms: Using the Size Conversions and Plans
routes.description: The terms for using Size Chart: how its size conversions are meant to be used, what a paid plan covers, and why each brand's own chart wins.
routes.navLabel: Size Chart Terms: Using the Size Conversions and Plans

toolSpecs.title: Find my size
toolSpecs.jtbd: From a category, a worn size or the visitor's bust/waist/hip/foot length in cm or in, and a target country or verified brand, return exactly one size, one between-sizes recommendation, and that brand's runs-small or runs-large note.

output.label: One size, the between-sizes rule and the brand note
output.description: The answer panel: the single size to buy written as one label (for example UK 12) in the largest type on the page, a line naming the size it came from and the category and market it is read in, a rule

toolSpecs.privacyNote: The lookup runs in your browser against a table shipped with the page. Nothing you type is uploaded, stored on a server or used to train anything.

toolPromises: From a category, a worn size or the visitor's bust/waist/hip/foot length in cm or in, and a target country or verified brand, return exactly one size, one between-sizes recommendation, and that brand's runs-small or runs-large note.
